headline: Whispering Fen Expansion & Economic Rebalance
summary: Following recent beta feedback from the Explorer and Economy councils, this update brings enhanced coin discovery bonuses to Whispering Fen, introduces a temporary market discount experiment, and lays out backlog tasks for onboarding tutorials and route completion logs.

development_focus.title: Route Discovery and Mid-Tier Economy Pacing
development_focus.reason: Address feedback regarding long-term collection tracking and bridge the currency gap between standard cosmetics and premium crown items.

experiment.reason: Provide a temporary economic cushion for players saving up toward high-value cosmetic items.

challenge.title: Fen Pearl Expedition
challenge.description: Traverse the Whispering Fen and successfully collect rare marsh specimens while avoiding bog thorns.

content_pack.title: Mist-Covered Bounty
content_pack.description: Increased coin yields and mysterious rumors emerge from the deep fog of the Whispering Fen.

development_backlog.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
development_backlog.reason: First-time players need immediate clarity on movement and combat interactions during early route steps.

development_backlog.title: Route Discovery Log UI
development_backlog.reason: Explorers need an in-game tracking mechanism to view collected items and monitor completion milestones.

development_backlog.title: Elite Enemy Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
development_backlog.reason: Combat challengers requested higher enemy pressure and distinct behavior profiles on tougher routes.

development_backlog.title: High-Contrast UI Theme Toggle
development_backlog.reason: Accessibility council highlighted the need for optional high-contrast visual modes to improve readability.

development_backlog.title: Explicit Input Buffering Feedback
development_backlog.reason: Clearer visual or text indicators when movement inputs collide with static hazards or obstacle states.
